items.titleZh: 拉塞尔：梅赛德斯在墨西哥大奖赛练习中未处最佳调校区间
items.summaryZh: 拉塞尔表示，升级后的梅赛德斯赛车在墨西哥大奖赛周五练习中未能进入最佳调校区间，他再次遇到调校难题。

media.altZh: 拉塞尔：梅赛德斯在墨西哥大奖赛练习中未处最佳调校区间 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Mercedes out of performance window at Mexico GP - George Russell
items.summaryEn: George Russell said the upgraded Mercedes was outside the optimum set-up window in Friday practice at the Mexico Grand Prix, as he again struggled to find the right set-up.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯在墨西哥大奖赛未处最佳性能区间——乔治·拉塞尔
拉塞尔再次面临难以让升级后的梅赛德斯F1赛车进入最佳调校区间的困难
乔治·拉塞尔在升级后的梅赛德斯F1赛车上遭遇更多困难，因为该车在墨西哥大奖赛周五练习中未能处于最佳调校区间。
这支领跑积分榜的车队本月为马来西亚站引入了升级版W17，但该车被红牛车手马克斯·维斯塔潘轻松击败，随后在新加坡站也出现了类似情况。
安东内利在奥斯汀从杆位起步获胜，终结了维斯塔潘的连胜，但他的梅赛德斯队友拉塞尔近三站却接连遭遇退赛、第九名和第八名。
拉塞尔将此归因于升级套件的工作窗口很窄，他认为这一点在墨西哥再次显现，尽管他在第二节练习中排名第三，仅落后法拉利标杆勒克莱尔十分之一秒。
“我觉得我们仍未完全吃透新套件，”拉塞尔说道，他的赛车在首节练习中由弗雷德里克·维斯蒂驾驶。
“我们看到存在一些平衡性限制，我们正努力克服却难以解决。”
“我想说目前对基米和我来说，我们可能更多在窗口之外，类似于我们在马来西亚看到的情况，而不是像基米在奥斯汀那样处于窗口之内。”
“但希望过夜之后我们能把它调回那个状态。”
勒克莱尔在周五的两节练习中都排名第一，这对拉塞尔来说并不意外，他将法拉利列为周末前的热门，因为其在高海拔条件下没有涡轮迟滞。
这对在墨西哥取得成功至关重要，因为在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道这样的赛道上涡轮工作更吃力，而众所周知SF-26的涡轮比对手更小。
不过，这并不是阻碍梅赛德斯的唯一方面，因为当被追问赛车需要在哪些方面改进时，拉塞尔回答说：“平衡。”
“过弯平衡没有达到我们想要的状态，赛车整体也不像我们希望的那样协调，所以是的，这需要一些工作。”
但对梅赛德斯来说，现在还不是恐慌的时候，尤其是勒克莱尔在美国大奖赛周五的两节练习中都名列前茅——结果随后安东内利却占据了统治地位。
“对我们来说，今天是扎实的一天——我会说不是特别惊艳，但很扎实，”副车队领队布拉德利·洛德说道。
“这里在动力单元冷却、刹车冷却以及这些涡轮的增压管理方面都有很多挑战，因为我们现在没有像过去几年那样有MGU-H来帮忙。”
“所以这是一个很难把所有事情都做对的地方，要在单圈中跑得快，同时还要能在长距离中保持节奏。”
“我们已经回答了一些问题。我们还需要进一步挖掘数据，找出明天和周日的最佳折中方案。”
detailEn: Mercedes out of performance window at Mexico GP - George Russell
Russell is again facing difficulties nailing the set-up window of the newly updated Mercedes F1 car
George Russell is enduring further difficulties with the upgraded Mercedes Formula 1 car, as it was outside the optimum set-up in Friday practice at the Mexico Grand Prix.
The championship-leading squad introduced an updated W17 for Malaysia this month, but it was easily beaten by Red Bull’s Max Verstappen before a similar story in Singapore.
Kimi Antonelli ended Verstappen’s run by winning from pole in Austin, but his Mercedes team-mate Russell has been struggling with a DNF, P9 and P8 across the last three rounds.

Russell put this down to the upgrades having a narrow operating window, which he thinks was seen again in Mexico despite finishing third in FP2 and only a tenth behind Ferrari pacesetter Charles Lelcerc.
“I think still not fully on top of the new package,” claimed Russell, whose car was driven by Frederik Vesti in opening practice.
“We see there's some balance limitations we have that we're struggling to overcome.
"I would say currently for Kimi and I, we're probably more outside the window, similar to what we saw in Malaysia, than inside the window like Kimi achieved in Austin.
“But hopefully overnight we can get it back there.”
Leclerc topped both Friday sessions, which came as little surprise to Russell, who labelled Ferrari as the pre-weekend favourite due to its lack of turbo lag in the high altitude conditions.
This is crucial for success in Mexico as the turbo works harder at circuits like Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez and the SF-26 is known to have a smaller one than its rivals.
That is not the only aspect holding Mercedes back though, as when pressed on where the car needs to improve, Russell replied: “The balance.
“The through-corner balance isn’t where we want it and the car isn’t quite as together as we’d like it, so yeah it’s going to require a bit of work.”
But it is not panic stations for Mercedes just yet, particularly as Leclerc also topped both Friday practice sessions at the United States Grand Prix – only for Antonelli to subsequently dominate.
“Solid day for us, I'd say – not spectacular, but solid,” said deputy team principal Bradley Lord.

“There's a lot of challenges here with PU cooling, with brake cooling, with boost management with these turbos, now that we don't have an MGU-H to help us out with that as we have done for the last few years.
“So this is a tricky place to get everything right, to be quick on a single lap, but then also be able to maintain your pace for the long run.
“So we've answered a few of those questions. We've got a bit more digging to do through the data to find exactly the best compromise for tomorrow and Sunday.”

该升级赛车在马来西亚站被红牛车手维斯塔潘轻松击败，新加坡站情况类似。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes introduced an updated W17 for Malaysia this month.
The upgraded car was easily beaten by Red Bull's Max Verstappen in Malaysia, with a similar story in Singapore.

items.titleZh: 哈斯墨西哥站余下赛程由平川亮替换奥康
items.summaryZh: 哈斯车队在周六上午突然宣布，储备车手平川亮将取代埃斯特班·奥康出战墨西哥大奖赛余下赛程，奥康因此缺席本站剩余比赛。车队未说明换人原因，但确认并非奥康生病。

media.altZh: 哈斯墨西哥站余下赛程由平川亮替换奥康 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Ocon suddenly replaced at Haas for rest of Mexico F1 weekend
items.summaryEn: Haas unexpectedly announced on Saturday morning that reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa will replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the Mexico City Grand Prix. No reason was given for the change, but the team confirmed it is not due to illness for Ocon.
detailZh: 埃斯特班·奥康将缺席F1墨西哥大奖赛余下赛程，哈斯储备车手平川亮将替换他。
哈斯在周六上午出人意料地发布了一份简短声明，宣布了这一换人决定。
声明写道：“TGR哈斯F1车队储备车手平川亮将在本周墨西哥城大奖赛余下赛程中替换埃斯特班·奥康。”
“平川亮曾随丰田Gazoo Racing两次赢得FIA世界耐力锦标赛冠军，并赢得勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军。他于10月30日星期五在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道参加了第一节练习赛，这是他本赛季第三次驾驶VF-26参加自由练习，总排名第15。
这位日本车手将在周六的最后一节练习和排位赛以及周日71圈的大奖赛中与队友奥利·贝尔曼搭档——这将是平川的F1正赛首秀。
目前不会发表进一步声明。
此次更换未给出任何原因，但哈斯车队已确认并非因为奥康生病。
因此，合理的推断是他似乎已被安排坐冷板凳。
奥康与哈斯车队关系破裂的所有原因
奥康在墨西哥经历了一个令人沮丧的周五，在第二次自由练习中公开表达了对自己的运行计划的不满——这是他当天唯一一节驾驶赛车的时间，此前平川亮在第一次自由练习中出场，以满足新秀练习规则。
他的圈速并不差——在第二次自由练习中从平川亮手中拿回赛车后，奥康击败了队友奥利·贝尔曼，最终位列第13名，成绩尚可——但他与工程师劳拉·穆勒在无线电中出现了摩擦。
劳拉·穆勒：我们把高油量运行换成了中性胎，因为奥利的轮胎状况不太好。
埃斯特班·奥康：还在用软胎，对吧？
LM：不，我们得用中性胎。
EO：不，不，我想要软胎，别这样对我。拜托。
奥康在练习结束后在围场里明显不满，他戴着头盔回到了哈斯车队的接待区。
哈斯车队已经决定在2027年用法拉利青训车手拉斐尔·卡马拉替换奥康，并在9月底宣布了奥康的离队。
卡马拉击败了丰田支持的平川亮等车手，锁定了这个席位。
这位31岁的新秀会是丰田的下一位F1车手吗？
两届WEC冠军平川亮自2024年底以来已为迈凯伦、阿尔派和哈斯完成多次F1练习赛出场，并长期表示目标是参加F1比赛。
他将成为自2014年比利时大奖赛时年32岁的安德烈·洛特勒代表卡特汉姆车队出战以来，最年长的F1首秀车手。
该车队对其巴西下一站的车手阵容不予置评，这与其声明保持一致。
detailEn: Esteban Ocon will sit out the rest of Formula 1's Mexican Grand Prix with Haas reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa replacing him.
Haas unexpectedly released a short statement on Saturday morning announcing the switch.
"TGR Haas F1 team reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa will replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix," the statement read.

"Hirakawa, a two-time winner of the FIA World Endurance Championship and 24 Hours of Le Mans Winner with Toyota Gazoo Racing, participated in FP1 at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday 30 October - his third free practice outing of the season driving the VF-26, finishing 15th overall.
"The Japanese driver will partner team-mate Ollie Bearman through final practice and qualifying on Saturday and Sunday's 71-lap grand prix - Hirakawa's Formula 1 race debut.
"No further statements will be made at this time."
No reason has been given for the change but Haas has confirmed it is not due to illness for Ocon.
It is logical therefore to reason that he appears to have been benched.
All the reasons the Ocon-Haas relationship fell apart

Ocon had a frustrating Friday in Mexico, publicly expressing his dissatisfaction with his runplan in FP2 - his only session in the car, after Hirakawa drove in FP1 to satisfy the rookie practice rule.

His time was not bad - after getting the car back off Hirakawa for FP2, Ocon beat team-mate Ollie Bearman to end up a respectable 13th - but there was friction on the radio with his engineer Laura Mueller.
Laura Mueller: We've swapped the high fuel run to medium because Ollie's [tyre] appearance is not great.
Esteban Ocon: Still doing soft, right?
LM: No, we have to do medium.
EO: No, no, I wanted the soft, like, don't do that to me. Come on.
Ocon was visibly dissatisfied in the paddock after the session, keeping his helmet on as he returned to Haas's hospitality unit.
Haas has already decided to replace Ocon with Ferrari junior Rafael Camara for 2027, announcing his exit at the end of September.
Camara beat the likes of Toyota-backed driver Hirakawa to secure the seat.
Is this 31-year-old rookie Toyota's next F1 driver?
Two-time WEC champion Hirakawa has completed multiple F1 practice outings for McLaren, Alpine and Haas since the end of 2024, with a long-stated aim of racing in F1.
He will become the oldest F1 debutant since then-32-year-old Andre Lotterer drove for Caterham at the Belgian GP in 2014.
The team is making no comment on its driver line-up for the next race in Brazil, in keeping with its statement.
keyPointsZh: 平川亮曾在丰田Gazoo Racing赢得两次FIA世界耐力锦标赛冠军和勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军。
平川亮周五第一节练习赛驾驶VF-26排名第15，这是他本赛季第三次自由练习出场。
平川亮将在周六最后一场练习赛和排位赛以及周日71圈正赛中搭档奥利·贝尔曼，这将是他F1正赛首秀。
keyPointsEn: Hirakawa is a two-time FIA World Endurance Championship winner and a 24 Hours of Le Mans winner with Toyota Gazoo Racing.
Hirakawa finished 15th overall in FP1 at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday 30 October, his third free practice outing of the season in the VF-26.
Hirakawa will partner Ollie Bearman through final practice and qualifying on Saturday and Sunday's 71-lap grand prix, which will be his Formula 1 race debut.
